metadata.domain: Developer Tooling — Software Supply Chain Security
bdd_focus_alignment: PURL-type dispatch routes each dependency to the correct backend
OSV.dev fixture-driven vulnerability lookup for npm/golang/cargo/composer/hex/pub/swift
GHSA fixture-driven vulnerability lookup for pkg:github/* PURLs
Preserve PyPI NVD path — backward compatibility with parent session tests
Strip fabricated CPEs from CycloneDX/SPDX output for non-NVD-indexed ecosystems
Cache sync required before lookup (actionable error)
Unknown PURL types apply fallback behaviour (skip with warning, no fabricated lookup)
Determinism — same inputs always produce identical outputs

capability_id_glossary.CAP-DISPATCH: PURL-type-based dispatch routing each dependency to the correct vulnerability backend
capability_id_glossary.CAP-NVD-PRESERVED: Backward-compatible NVD cache lookup for NVD-indexed ecosystems
capability_id_glossary.CAP-CACHE-PATTERN: Cache pattern parity with parent NVDCacheManager (sync + in-memory dict)
capability_id_glossary.CAP-O1-DISPATCH: Deterministic dispatch overhead at O(1) per dep via dict lookup

scenarios.name: Mixed ecosystem scan — all three backends hit, dispatch counts correct, 5 vulnerabilities found
scenarios.description: Feed mixed_repo_deps (2 PyPI deps, 3 OSV deps spanning npm+golang, 1 GitHub Action) through EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper.map_vulnerabilities. Verifies that dispatch routes each dep to the correct backend, that all three caches contribute hits, and that the merged result contains exactly 5 vulnerability records. Note: the lodash@4.17.20 dep is the BOUNDARY (fixed) version — it is correctly dispatched to OSV but returns no match.

expected_output._dispatch_counts_note: These are result-record counts by source. Lodash@4.17.20 IS dispatched to OSV but yields no record (boundary fixed version). For dispatch event counts use scenario assertions section.

assertions: Mapper returns a list of length 5
Each vuln record carries a 'backend' tag indicating which cache produced it
Counts of records per backend match dispatch_counts exactly
lodash@4.17.20 is dispatched to OSV (verified via mock spy or counter) but produces no record because 4.17.20 is the fixed version
No NVD cache lookups were attempted for any pkg:npm/*, pkg:golang/*, or pkg:github/* PURL

scenarios.name: PyPI-only regression — parent NVD path unchanged, zero OSV/GHSA lookups attempted
scenarios.description: Backward-compatibility guard. Feed pypi_only_deps (a pure PyPI subset of the parent TaskMatrix scan) through the enhanced mapper. The output must match the parent VulnerabilityMapper's output for the same deps, byte-for-byte where possible, and ZERO calls must be made to OSV or GHSA caches.

expected_output._dispatch_counts_note: These are result-record counts. 5 PyPI deps are dispatched to NVD, but only 3 (langchain, requests, lxml) have NVD entries. openai@0.27.2 and pydantic@1.10.4 are clean.

assertions: Output vulnerability set equals the parent VulnerabilityMapper output for the same deps
OSVCache.lookup spy was called zero times
GHSACache.lookup spy was called zero times
Parent session test command (pytest -k 'pypi or nvd') still passes against the integrated build

scenarios.name: GitHub Actions only — GHSA dispatch path and CPE field absent from emitted SBOM
scenarios.description: Feed github_actions_only_deps through the enhanced mapper AND the CPE-sanitizing CycloneDXSerializer. Verifies that all three deps are dispatched to GHSA, that all three produce vulnerability records, and that the resulting CycloneDX components contain ZERO cpe strings (the fabricated Syft-emitted CPEs are stripped at serialization time).
assertions: Emitted CycloneDX document contains exactly 3 components
No component has a 'cpe' key (json.dumps of components contains no 'cpe' field)
Every component retains its 'purl' key unchanged
All 3 GHSA advisories are present in the vulnerabilities array of the emitted document

scenarios.name: Unknown PURL type — fallback applies, scan does not error, warning logged
scenarios.description: Feed a dep with an unknown PURL type (pkg:unknownftype/foo@1.0) through the mapper. The dispatch table has no entry for 'unknownftype'. Per fallback_behaviour=skip_with_log_warning, the mapper must return an empty vulnerability list for that dep, log a structured warning indicating the skipped purl type, and NOT crash the scan.

log_warnings.message: Skipped vulnerability lookup for unknown PURL type 'unknownftype' on dep foo@1.0

assertions: Mapper returns an empty list of vulnerabilities for this dep
Exactly one warning is logged with code 'dispatch.unknown_purl_type'
No call is made to NVDCacheManager.lookup, OSVCache.lookup, or GHSACache.lookup
Mapper does not raise

scenarios.name: Empty deps list — mapper returns empty result without errors
scenarios.description: Pass an empty deps list to the mapper. Result must be an empty list. No backend calls. No warnings. No errors. Smoke-test of the empty-input contract.
assertions: Mapper returns []
No backend lookup is invoked
No exception raised
No log line at WARNING or above is emitted

scenarios.name: Offline / un-synced OSV cache — actionable error raised, scan does not silently crash
scenarios.description: Construct OSVCache without calling sync() and pass a dep that would route to OSV. The mapper must raise an actionable error from OSVCache.lookup indicating that the cache has not been initialised. The error must be a typed exception (not a bare KeyError), and the message must direct the user to run sync first.

expected_output.exception_message_contains: OSV cache not initialized; run sync first

assertions: OSVCacheNotSyncedError is raised (or equivalent named exception class — NOT KeyError, NOT generic Exception)
Exception message contains the substring 'sync'
No partial result list is returned (mapper either returns fully or raises, never a half-populated result)

scenarios.name: CPE sanitization on serialization — mixed components, PyPI keeps CPE, npm/github/golang strip CPE
scenarios.description: Feed a mixed components list (one PyPI, one npm, one GitHub Action, one Go) — all carrying CPE strings (fabricated for non-NVD ecosystems, legitimate for PyPI) — through CPESanitizingCycloneDXSerializer. Assert that ONLY the PyPI component retains its cpe field in the emitted JSON; the npm, github, and golang components have it stripped.
assertions: Components[0] (PyPI) retains its 'cpe' key
Components[1] (npm) has no 'cpe' key
Components[2] (github) has no 'cpe' key
Components[3] (golang) has no 'cpe' key
All four components retain their 'purl' key unchanged
Equivalent assertions hold for SPDXSerializer (CPE is removed from externalRefs entries with referenceType=cpe23Type for non-NVD components)

scenarios.name: Cache sync from fixture file — OSVCache.sync() loads records, subsequent lookup succeeds
scenarios.description: Given a path to an OSV fixture JSON file (the enhancement's step1b_mock_entities.json OSVVulnerabilityRecord array, serialized to a standalone fixture), call OSVCache.sync(source_path). After sync, OSVCache.is_synced() returns True, and OSVCache.lookup('pkg:npm/minimist@1.2.5') returns the corresponding OSV record. Verifies the parent NVDCacheManager.sync pattern is correctly mirrored.
assertions: is_synced() returns False before sync(), True after
lookup of known-vulnerable purl returns exactly one record matching the fixture
lookup of clean purl returns empty list (not None, not error)
sync() is idempotent — calling it twice with the same path does not duplicate records
No outbound network call during sync() — fixture is read from local filesystem only

scenarios.name: Determinism — two runs of the full enhanced pipeline produce byte-identical output
scenarios.description: Run scenario_enh_001 twice in succession against the same inputs and caches. Capture the emitted CycloneDX JSON each time. Assert byte-equality. Validates the determinism success metric — no timestamps in matcher output, no nondeterministic ordering of merged results.
assertions: json.dumps(run_1_output, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(run_2_output, sort_keys=True)
Vulnerability records appear in the same order in both runs (stable sort by purl, then by advisory id)
No timestamp fields appear in matcher output
No random uuid-bearing fields appear in matcher output
